# Bored Mutant

> Custom AI tools for small businesses. Independent automation studio run by one engineer. Fixed scope, fixed fee, agreed in writing before any payment. Timeline depends on scope — agreed upfront, never open-ended. Built around the tools the business already uses (CRMs, AMS, MLS, accounting, email, document workflows). Typical clients are 5–50 person professional services firms: insurance agencies, real estate brokerages, accounting firms, and similar.

Contact: contact@boredmutant.com
Booking: https://cal.com/boredmutant (15-minute intro call)

## What we build

- **Insurance agencies** — quote and policy data flowing between carrier portals and the agency AMS automatically; ACORDs and certificates generated in seconds.
- **Real estate brokerages** — listings, contracts, and client follow-ups handled automatically across CRM, MLS, and email.
- **Accounting & professional services** — invoices, document collection, and client onboarding automated end-to-end, in the firm's own format.
- **Other industries** — same pattern. Wherever staff are re-typing the same data between systems, the work can be automated. Every build is custom to the client's workflow.

## How we work

1. 15-minute call — the prospect shows the manual task wasting the most time.
2. Build — fixed price and timeline agreed in writing, before any payment.
3. Handover — short handover and 30 days of support included.

## Why

- Work directly with the engineer who writes the code. No account managers, no handoffs.
- Fixed price and fixed timeline agreed before any payment changes hands.
- Built around existing tools — clients don't change how they work.

## How we're different

- Engineer, not an agency. The person on the call writes the code.
- Custom code, not a vendor subscription. Runs on your accounts; you own the repository.
- Fixed fee agreed before any payment.
- (For technical readers: most recent solo project was a 56,000-line autonomous AI system, shipped in under four months.)
